critical_code_review_comments: CSS light mode overrides in index.css correctly target hardcoded CRM Tailwind classes (bg-[#171717], border-[#262626], text-[#A3A3A3], etc.)
Theme toggle uses data-theme attribute on document.documentElement and persists to localStorage
Language switching uses react-i18next with t() function passed through CRMContext
All CRM components properly use t() hooks for translatable strings
Blue action buttons correctly preserve white text in light mode via CSS specificity rules
context_for_next_testing_agent: CRM light/dark mode and i18n (EN/FR/DE) fully tested and working. Theme toggle at bottom of sidebar (sun/moon icon). Language selector (globe icon) opens dropdown with EN/FR/DE options. CSS overrides in index.css handle light mode remapping of hardcoded dark Tailwind classes. All 10 CRM sub-components have t() translation hooks implemented.
